mapper.select: SELECT id,user_key,username,display_name,password_hash,status FROM sys_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='active' ORDER BY r.role_key

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_key FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.status='active' AND p.status='active' ORDER BY p.permission_key
SELECT id,password_hash FROM sys_user WHERE username='admin'
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE username=#{username}
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_key='platform_admin' AND status='active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_role (user_id,role_id,scope_type,scope_id) SELECT #{userId},#{roleId},'global','*' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND role_id=#{roleId} AND scope_type='global' AND scope_id='*')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at=#{loggedAt} WHERE id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_login_throttle WHERE principal_key_hash=#{keyHash} AND blocked_until > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_login_throttle (principal_key_hash,window_started_at,failed_attempts,blocked_until) VALUES (#{keyHash},#{now},1,NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE failed_attempts=IF(window_started_at < DATE_SUB(VALUES(window_started_at),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE),1,LEAST(failed_attempts+1,5)), blocked_until=IF(failed_attempts >= 5,DATE_ADD(VALUES(window_started_at),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE),blocked_until), window_started_at=IF(window_started_at < DATE_SUB(VALUES(window_started_at),INTERVAL 15 MINUTE),VALUES(window_started_at),window_started_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE user_key=#{userKey}

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND r.role_key='platform_admin' AND p.permission_key='system.config.update' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')
SELECT id FROM api_client WHERE client_key=#{clientKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_client_permission (client_id,permission_id) SELECT #{clientId},id FROM sys_permission WHERE permission_key='machine.ingest.submit' AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_source ds JOIN asset a ON a.id=#{assetId} AND a.status='active' WHERE ds.id=#{dataSourceId} AND ds.status='active')
SELECT client_key,client_type,credential_sha256 FROM api_client WHERE id=#{clientId} AND status='active' AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
SELECT p.permission_key FROM api_client_permission cp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=cp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE cp.client_id=#{clientId} ORDER BY p.permission_key
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user
SELECT id, user_key, username, display_name, status FROM sys_user ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, role_key, name, description FROM sys_role WHERE is_builtin = 1 AND status = 'active' ORDER BY role_key
SELECT p.permission_key FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id AND p.status = 'active' WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_key
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_key = #{roleKey} AND is_builtin = 1 AND status = 'active'

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM data_source WHERE id = CAST(#{scopeId} AS UNSIGNED))
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM model_version WHERE model_key = #{scopeId})

mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'active' AND r.status = 'active' AND r.role_key = 'platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type = 'global' AND ur.scope_id = '*' ORDER BY u.id FOR UPDATE
